correctness.rationale: Explicit conic complement and nonic separator are checked by 57 exact finite-field point incidences. Frobenius minors generate the radical full 57-point ideal; multiplication by the separator yields the exact Hilbert series from the eight-point transverse conic complete intersection. Direct modular evaluation ranks match the Hilbert function through degree 11 and reach 49; all later degrees follow by rank stabilization, not finite extrapolation. Hilbert-Burch and minimal generators force syzygy degrees 9,11,13. The included standalone verifier reproduces the finite checks.
